$comment: D4.46 — Generation Integrity and Release Enforcement. One record per acceptance criterion, each with the evidence that shows it met and the test that fails if it breaks.
Measured on 16 October 2026 against commit 8c73f15b6 (D4.45) plus the D4.46 working tree. The term sheet stays withdrawn; nothing here restores it.
No legal proposition was decided here. Every requirement remains draft-needs-legal-review; 'Automated checks passed' is still not a legal approval.
review_status: engineering — requirement content awaits advocate review

acceptance.statement: User-supplied commercial values survive generation, repair, AI tailoring, validation and export unchanged unless the user authorises a new value.
how: backend/services/mutationGuard.js: one rule on every path that changes rendered text. A user figure the clause carried must still be in it; AI may not introduce a figure; a refused change keeps the previous text and is recorded in metadata.refused_mutations.
deterministicFixer no longer rewrites rates (>=40% -> 24%) or MSME periods (>=60 days -> 45 days); the concern stays a finding.
NDA_TERM_SURVIVAL_001 now renders agreement_term; it used to state 'two (2) years' whatever the user entered.
The AI path starts from the variable-injected seed, so the baseline it is judged against carries the user's values.

acceptance.statement: Clause locks are enforced on every mutation path, including /fix-issue.
how: One protected set (PROTECTED_CATEGORIES, PROTECTED_CLAUSE_IDS) read by clauseLocker, the AI merge and every guard. repairDocumentIssue passes AI edits through guardDraftMutation and returns fixed:false with the refusals and the reason.

acceptance.statement: AI integrity checks use immutable pre-transformation evidence.
how: metadata.pre_ai_baseline is written once, before any AI change, and never reset. validateAIIntegrity compares every clause whose text is still exactly the AI's (_ai_text_sha) with it; a clause the user later edited is the user's and is not judged. AI_CHANGED_AGREED_TERMS is CRITICAL. The check holds although baseline_clause_map is reset to the AI text.

acceptance.statement: Applicable, verified BLOCK requirements prevent release.
how: backend/services/requirementRelease.js runs the existing assessRequirements as a validation layer; no second evaluator. The response's requirement report and the release decision are compared on every generated corpus world and are identical.

Each of the 34 BLOCK requirements audited individually (governance/block-requirements-audit.json, scripts/auditBlockRequirements.mjs): 23 ACTIVE_BLOCK; 11 held — 7 because no fixture world of CHEQUE_BOUNCE_NOTICE or POWER_OF_ATTORNEY generates (no evidence is not passing evidence), 3 for missing or unreachable satisfier clauses, 1 (MOU NON_BINDING_CHARACTER) because character is a legal judgment. A held requirement unmet gives 'Requires legal review'. A BLOCK requirement absent from the audit is held.

acceptance.statement: Material contradictions such as the NDA's period conflict cannot receive a clean validation result.
how: The frozen NDA (24 months in Duration of Confidentiality; a two-year term and three further years in Term and Survival; old result 'Automated checks passed', 100) is now Blocked with MATERIAL_CONTRADICTION quoting both periods.

Relationships compare periods, not digits (answer_kind DURATION): 24 months equals two (2) years; 90 days does not equal 3 months; text that is not a period is unread, never agreement. A clause that defers by name (declared 'defers' pattern) states no second answer.
The engine no longer produces the contradiction: Term and Survival defers to Duration of Confidentiality.
A relationship that cannot be read is 'Requires legal review', neither Blocked nor passed.

acceptance.statement: 'Requires information' and 'Requires legal review' are distinct from Blocked and from 'Automated checks passed'.
how: validation.release_outcome: BLOCKED > REQUIRES_INFORMATION > REQUIRES_LEGAL_REVIEW > REVIEW_REQUIRED > AUTOMATED_CHECKS_PASSED; validation.certification carries the label. A blocking finding always wins.

Five requirement states, each in validation.requirements: VIOLATED (blocks only an ACTIVE_BLOCK requirement), EVIDENCE_MISSING (information or legal review by cause), APPLICABILITY_UNRESOLVED (information; never treated as met or not applicable), NOT_APPLICABLE (with the condition not met), SATISFIED (with the satisfying clauses).
Withdrawn and superseded outputs: 'Requires legal review' (was 'Requires review').

acceptance.statement: Each repaired defect has positive, negative, boundary and regression tests, including cross-family checks.

tests.tests/generationIntegrity.test.mjs: 25 checks: regression on the frozen repair override; end-to-end 48% loan; guard boundaries (re-formatting is not a change; the engine may add a figure, the AI may not); AI merge refusal and acceptance; immutable-baseline check; user edits not judged; /fix-issue refusals; one protected set.
tests.tests/ndaContradiction.test.mjs: 20 checks: frozen NDA blocked; the engine no longer produces it; user term and period survive; contradictions caught in both library phrasings and when planted; same period in different words and deferral are not contradictions; unreadable, mutually deferring and single-clause boundaries; unit normalisation.
tests.tests/releaseEnforcement.test.mjs: 17 checks: the audit (34, once each; NOT_TESTED held; unaudited held); ACTIVE_BLOCK blocks (loan without principal); HELD gives legal review (rental without premises); MOU contradicted character; SHA requires information; applicability unresolved; ledger evidence and reasons; precedence; cross-family over every generated world of the 9 families with requirements.

acceptance.statement: The 16 failing suites remain explicitly tracked; no claim of a fully passing suite.
how: Recorded in governance/suite-baseline.json (after_D4_46). Each of the 16 was run on 8c73f15b6 and on D4.46 and its output compared.

release_effect_on_the_corpus.$what: Conservation gate, 217 cases, before and after (governance/provenance-instrumentation.json, rebaseline of 16 Oct 2026, D4.46). Shipping status and clause order unchanged.

no_longer_automated_checks_passed.MOU: NON_BINDING_CHARACTER contradicted by dispute resolution, governing law, survival and termination -> Requires legal review

now_requires_information.SHAREHOLDERS_AGREEMENT: transfer restrictions cannot be checked against Articles never supplied
now_requires_information.MASTER_SERVICE_AGREEMENT (QUICK_ESSENTIA: two requirements whose applicability nobody established

text_changed.NDA: Term and Survival takes the user's term and defers to Duration of Confidentiality
text_changed.EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT: survival list now names indemnity and limitation of liability (see SURVIVAL_LIST_STALE_AFTER_INJECTION)

found_and_not_fixed: SURVIVAL_LIST_STALE_AFTER_INJECTION (P1): protections injected after the survival clause is rendered; 8 of 113 shipped documents name fewer surviving provisions than they contain. The text depends on whether the repair round ran.
MOU_NON_BINDING_ALWAYS_APPLIES (P2, legal): applies to an MOU the user declares Binding.
REQUIREMENT_GAPS_SURFACED (P1, legal): Employment POSH provision, Rental delivery of possession.
BLOCK_REQUIREMENTS_UNTESTED_ON_CORPUS (P2): CHEQUE_BOUNCE_NOTICE and POWER_OF_ATTORNEY never generate in the fixture corpus.

The response's requirement report and the release decision call the same evaluator twice with inputs shown equal on the corpus; making buildSuccess reuse the validation's assessment would remove the second call.
term_sheet: Still withdrawn. Nothing in D4.46 changes that.
